global_rules.rule: All case data lives under a case folder named CASE_ID (format: LastName_MMDDYYYY, where the date is the patient’s DOB). CASE_ID is used in all audit log entries, Slack posts, and file references.
All dates written in files must use the YYYY‑MM‑DD format unless a different format is explicitly required.
Append one row to audit_log.xlsx at each major checkpoint. Columns: Date | CASE_ID | Action | File_Updated | Field_Updated | New_Value | Staff_User | Result (SUCCESS / FAILED / STOP — reason).
When a validation condition fails, log a row with Action = 'Stop Protocol', set File_Updated, Field_Updated, New_Value to N/A, and hold the case until the issue is resolved by a supervisor.

Before making a phone call, verify that the required information already exists in email, referral documents, or other input files. If the information is unavailable and a call cannot be made, trigger the Stop Protocol.
Any file access outside the role‑specific read/write matrix must be logged in audit_log.xlsx with Action = 'Out‑of‑Scope Access' and reported to compliance@careig.com.
All communications use the defined Slack channels; claims are submitted by email with PDF attachments; no proprietary EHR, clearinghouse portal, or payer portal is required.
If a situation is not covered by the SOP, stop work, note the event in audit_log.xlsx, and immediately contact the direct supervisor using the escalation path in Section 12.

triage.name: Initial Case Triage
steps: 1. Referral received → create case folder and populate intake.xlsx. STOP if referral lacks required patient identifiers.
2. Send consent form → set intake.xlsx.Consent_Status = 'Form Sent'. STOP if consent cannot be sent electronically.
3. Receive signed consent → update intake.xlsx.Consent_Status = 'Signed' and assign a Benefits Verification Specialist (BVS). STOP if signed consent not received within 5 business days.
4. BVS completes Benefits Verification → populate all required columns in benefits.xlsx and set BV_Complete = 'YES'. STOP if any required field remains blank.
5. If PA_Required = 'YES', BVS submits Prior Authorization → set auth.xlsx.PA_Submission_Date and PA_Status = 'Pending'. STOP if PA submission fails or required contact information is missing.
6. PA approved → update auth.xlsx.PA_Status = 'Approved' and record PA_Number. STOP if PA is denied or expires before the planned DOS.
7. Clinical handoff → set clinical.xlsx.Handoff_Status = 'Received'. STOP if handoff not logged within 1 business day of PA approval.
8. Nurse scheduling → enter clinical.xlsx.Visit_Date and Nurse_Assigned after confirming Supply_Checklist_Complete = 'YES'. STOP if supply checklist is incomplete.
9. Nurse completes infusion visit → fill visit_note.xlsx completely and obtain Nurse_Signature within 4 hours. STOP if Nurse_Signature is missing.
10. Billing validation → run Pre‑Billing Validation (Section 10.1). STOP if any validation rule fails.
11. Build and submit claim → populate claim.xlsx and send by email. STOP if claim submission fails.

housekeeping.name: Ongoing Maintenance & Compliance
steps: Maintain the file system structure exactly as listed in Section 3; never edit template files in place.
Append‑only updates to audit_log.xlsx; never delete rows.
Log any out‑of‑scope file access (Action = 'Out‑of‑Scope Access') and email compliance@careig.com.
Perform daily supervisory review of open cases (Section 12.2) and send any missing Slack alerts.
Back‑up case folders nightly to the secure shared drive.
Ensure all Slack notifications include the CASE_ID and relevant data as defined in the workflow summary.

priority.name: Case Priority Levels
levels: High – PA pending > 5 days, claim unpaid > 30 days, patient balance > $500, or any STOP Protocol triggered.
Medium – Standard workflow with no alerts, upcoming DOS within 7 days.
Low – Cases awaiting patient‑initiated actions (e.g., signed consent) with no time‑sensitive deadlines.

escalation.name: Escalation Pathways
steps: PA pending > 5 days → post to #intake-mgmt with [PA DELAY] and supervisor follows up with payer.
Claim unpaid, no ERA after 30 days → post to #billing with [AR FOLLOWUP] and log call in claim.xlsx.AR_Followup_Log.
Payer underpayment vs contract → post to #billing-mgmt with [UNDERPAYMENT]; Director or contracting team reviews.
Patient balance > $500 unresolved → verify ≥3 contact attempts; if met, post to #billing-mgmt requesting collections authorization from Director.
Write‑off request > $200 → post to #billing-mgmt with [WRITE‑OFF REQUEST]; Director must approve before action.
Level 2 appeal denied → post to #billing-mgmt with [L2 DENIED]; Director decides next steps (write‑off, IRO, complaint).
Legal threat or attorney communication → STOP all work, post to #compliance with [LEGAL THREAT]; notify Director of Operations and legal@careig.com immediately.
Suspected fraud or billing abuse → STOP, post to #compliance with [COMPLIANCE REPORT]; call Compliance Hotline.
Wrong drug lot/dose from partner pharmacy → do not administer, document in clinical.xlsx.Drug_Issue_Notes, post to #clinical-scheduling with [DRUG ISSUE].
must_not: Modify any case file without first logging the action in audit_log.xlsx.
Ignore a Stop Protocol; work must not continue until the issue is cleared.
Respond to legal or compliance threats outside of the #compliance channel or without Director/Legal notification.
Bill a service that has not been verified as covered in benefits.xlsx.

definitions.CASE_ID: Unique case folder name using the format LastName_MMDDYYYY where the date is the patient’s date of birth.
definitions.DOS: Date of Service – the date the patient received the infusion visit.
definitions.BV: Benefits Verification – the process of confirming coverage, deductible, coinsurance, etc., performed by the Benefits Verification Specialist.
definitions.PA: Prior Authorization – payer‑required approval for the drug and dose before infusion.
definitions.Stop Protocol: Procedure to halt work when a validation fails; log the stop in audit_log.xlsx and await supervisor clearance.
definitions.Supply_Checklist_Complete: Flag in clinical.xlsx indicating all required infusion supplies have been ordered, received, and verified.
definitions.Nurse_Signature: Electronic signature of the Infusion Nurse in visit_note.xlsx; required for claim submission.
definitions.Claim_Frequency_Code: Numeric code indicating claim type: 1 = original, 7 = corrected/resubmitted, 8 = void/duplicate.

procedures.name: IVIG Home Infusion – Intake to Billing
procedures.applies_when: A new IVIG home infusion case is received and must be processed from intake through billing.

inputs.source: Case Setup file (Columns: Patient_ID, Referral_Date, Prescribing_Physician)
Benefits Verification sheet (Columns: Payer, Coverage_Status, Copay_Amount)
Drug Source Decision matrix (Columns: Drug_Availability, Cost_Efficiency, Payer_Preference)
PA Documents repository (Files: Clinical_Note.pdf, Lab_Results.pdf, Formulary_Check.pdf)
Supply Checklist form (Columns: IVIG_Kit, Pump, Catheter, Consumables)
Visit Documentation template (Fields: Date_of_Service, Vital_Signs, Infusion_Details)
Pre‑Billing Validation report (Columns: CPT_Codes, Modifiers, Charge_Amount)

decisions.rule: If Benefits Verification shows Coverage_Status = 'Approved' AND Copay_Amount ≤ patient‑agreed amount
decisions.then: Proceed to Drug Source Decision
decisions.else: Trigger Financial Counseling (7.3) and pause further processing

decisions.rule: If Drug Source Decision matrix returns 'In‑Network Preferred'
decisions.then: Select in‑network drug source and continue
decisions.else: Document alternative source and obtain additional authorization

decisions.rule: If Prior Authorization submission receives PA Approval status
decisions.then: Proceed to Clinical Scheduling (9)
decisions.else: Execute PA Denial workflow (8.7) and initiate Denial Management (11)

decisions.rule: If Claim Submission returns a denial with CARC code listed in 11.1
decisions.then: Initiate Appeal Submission (11.2)

steps: 6.1 Case Setup – create case folder in the File System Structure and record patient data in the Case Setup file.
7.1 Benefits Verification – query payer portal and record results in the Benefits Verification sheet.
7.2 Drug Source Decision – apply the Drug Source Decision matrix and document the chosen source.
8.3 PA Submission – submit Prior Authorization via payer portal; record submission ID.
8.7 PA Denial – log denial reason, apply decision D4, and move to Denial Management.
9.3 Visit Documentation – after infusion, complete Visit Documentation template and attach to case file.
10.4 ERA & Payment Posting – receive ERA file, post payment to patient ledger, reconcile adjustments.
deadlines: Case Setup – within 1 business day of referral receipt.
Benefits Verification – within 2 business days of patient contact.
PA Submission – within 2 business days of benefits verification completion.
PA Follow‑Up – daily check; if no response in 48 hours, use Phone Call Workaround.
Nurse Scheduling – within 3 business days of PA approval.
Claim Submission – within 1 business day of visit documentation completion.
Appeal Submission – within 30 calendar days of denial receipt.
must_not: Do not alter or delete entries in the Audit Log (4.3).
Do not share any patient protected health information (PHI) via unsecured email or messaging (4.3).
Do not proceed to Clinical Scheduling without documented PA approval (4.3).
Do not use non‑approved drug sources when the Drug Source Decision matrix selects an in‑network option (4.3).
notes: Urgent cases flagged in the system should be prioritized for PA submission.
If a Stop Protocol is activated, all downstream steps must be paused until clearance is received.
Use the Phone Call Workaround (4.4) only after 48 hours of no electronic response.

links.when: Benefits verified and drug source selected
Any deadline missed or escalation required

procedures.name: 4.3 Prohibited Actions – Billing & Claim Submission Controls
procedures.applies_when: When processing IVIG drug billing, claim submission, balance write‑off, legal communications, or ICD‑10 coding.

inputs.fact: Director of Revenue Cycle approval status
Legal threat or attorney communication received
Physician documentation and PA approval for ICD‑10 code
inputs.source: clinical documentation and PA approval records

decisions.rule: clinical.xlsx col Drug_Source ≠ "CareIG"
decisions.then: Do not bill any IVIG drug J‑code.

decisions.rule: visit_note.xlsx col Premeds_Administered does NOT document drug, dose, route, time, and indication
decisions.then: Do not bill pre‑medication J‑codes.

decisions.rule: Dose_Administered_Grams is missing or zero
decisions.then: Do not use ordered dose for unit calculations; halt billing until administered dose is entered.
decisions.else: Use visit_note.xlsx col Dose_Administered_Grams for unit calculations.

decisions.rule: claim.xlsx col Submission_Date is populated for the same Date of Service (DOS)
decisions.then: Do not submit a claim.

decisions.rule: Balance > $200 AND Director of Revenue Cycle approval NOT recorded in #billing-mgmt
decisions.then: Do not write off the balance.

decisions.rule: Legal threat or attorney communication received
decisions.then: Do not respond; post to #compliance immediately.

decisions.rule: ICD‑10 code assigned is not supported by physician documentation AND PA approval
decisions.then: Do not assign the ICD‑10 code.

steps: Verify Drug_Source in clinical.xlsx; if not "CareIG", do not bill any IVIG drug J‑code.
Check Premeds_Administered in visit_note.xlsx; if documentation of drug, dose, route, time, and indication is missing, do not bill pre‑medication J‑codes.
Use Dose_Administered_Grams from visit_note.xlsx for all unit calculations; never use the ordered dose.
Search claim.xlsx for existing Submission_Date for the same DOS; if present, do not submit a new claim.
If Balance > $200, obtain Director of Revenue Cycle approval via Slack #billing-mgmt before writing off; otherwise, do not write off.
If any legal threat or attorney communication is received, do not respond; immediately post the communication to #compliance.
Assign ICD‑10 codes only when supported by physician documentation and PA approval; otherwise, do not assign.
deadlines: All verification steps must be completed before claim submission or billing entry.
must_not: Bill any IVIG drug J‑code when clinical.xlsx col Drug_Source ≠ CareIG.
Bill pre‑medication J‑codes without complete Premeds_Administered documentation.
Use ordered dose for unit calculations; always use visit_note.xlsx col Dose_Administered_Grams.
Submit a claim when claim.xlsx already has Submission_Date populated for the same DOS.
Write off any balance > $200 without Director of Revenue Cycle approval (Slack #billing-mgmt).
Respond to legal threats or attorney communications; instead post to #compliance immediately.
Assign an ICD‑10 code not supported by the physician's documentation and the PA approval.
notes: Prioritize verification of Drug_Source and Premeds_Administered before any billing entry.
Balance write‑off approvals must be captured in Slack #billing-mgmt for audit trail.
Legal communications are compliance‑only; avoid any direct reply.

procedures.name: 6.1 Case Setup
procedures.applies_when: A new referral document is received for a patient.

inputs.fact: Patient_Last_Name, First_Name, DOB, Address, Phone, Email

inputs.source: Referral document – ordered drug fields (dose converted to grams if supplied in mg)
Referral document – secondary insurance fields (if listed)
File system – template for new case

decisions.rule: Physician_NPI column is blank after referral entry
decisions.then: Post to #intake-alerts: "[INTAKE HOLD] CASE_ID — Physician NPI missing"; Email request for NPI to address in Physician_Email column; Halt further processing of this case.

steps: Copy intake_blank.xlsx to create intake.xlsx for this case.
Populate intake.xlsx columns from the referral document using the required field mapping table.
Convert any Drug_Dose values from mg to grams before entering into Drug_Dose_Grams column.
Set Consent_Status column in intake.xlsx to "Pending".
Log to audit_log.xlsx: Action = "Referral Received".
If Physician_NPI is blank, execute decision D1 (post alert, email request, and stop).
deadlines: All steps must be completed immediately upon receipt of the referral.
must_not: Do not proceed with case processing when Physician_NPI is missing.
notes: Ensure drug dose conversion to grams is accurate.
Email request must reference the missing Physician NPI and be sent to the address in the Physician_Email column.
Consent_Status must always be set to "Pending" at case creation.

procedures.name: 6.2 Patient Contact
procedures.applies_when: When a new case exists in intake.xlsx and patient contact has not yet been completed.

decisions.rule: If call answer = none
decisions.then: Leave voicemail verbatim and log No Answer / Voicemail.
decisions.else: Log Reached and proceed to consent step.

decisions.rule: If Contact_Attempt_Log has 3 entries and none = Reached
decisions.then: Post #intake-alerts [UNREACHABLE] CASE_ID — 3 failed attempts; complete Template 1 and email to Physician_Email; halt further processing.

decisions.rule: If Patient_Email is present
decisions.then: Email consent form; set Consent_Status = Form Sent.
decisions.else: Mail consent form to Patient_Address; note method in Contact_Attempt_Log; set Consent_Status = Form Sent.

decisions.rule: If BVS assigned and Consent_Status ≠ Signed
decisions.then: Post #intake-alerts [CONSENT MISSING] CASE_ID; do not begin BV.
decisions.else: Proceed with BV after BVS assignment.

steps: Call patient using number from intake.xlsx col Patient_Phone. Use verbatim script: "Hello, may I speak with [Patient Name]? This is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy. Dr. [Physician_Name] has referred you for home IVIG infusion therapy. I'm calling to verify your information and explain next steps. Do you have a few minutes?"

If no answer, leave voicemail verbatim (do not state diagnosis): "Hello, this is [Your Name] from CareIG Specialty Pharmacy at [Phone]. We received a referral from your physician. Please call us back at your convenience. Thank you."
Log each attempt in intake.xlsx col Contact_Attempt_Log as: [Date] [Time] — [Reached / No Answer / Voicemail].

Check Contact_Attempt_Log; if three entries exist and none is Reached, post to #intake-alerts: [UNREACHABLE] CASE_ID — 3 failed attempts; complete Template 1 (Unable to Reach Patient — Email to Referring Physician) and email to intake.xlsx col Physician_Email; STOP further steps.
When patient is reached, confirm demographics, explain consent requirement, and send consent form:
If Patient_Email exists, email consent form to intake.xlsx col Patient_Email with subject "CareIG — Consent Form Required | [Patient Last Name]"; set intake.xlsx col Consent_Status = Form Sent.
If Patient_Email missing, mail consent form to intake.xlsx col Patient_Address; note mailing method in Contact_Attempt_Log; set intake.xlsx col Consent_Status = Form Sent.

Use spoken script: "Before we schedule your visit, a signed Consent for Treatment and Financial Responsibility form is required. Once we verify your insurance, we will also contact you with your estimated out‑of‑pocket costs before scheduling."
When signed consent is received, save as consent_signed.pdf and set intake.xlsx col Consent_Status = Signed.

Assign a BVS; set intake.xlsx col BVS_Assigned; post to #intake-team: [BVS ASSIGNED] CASE_ID | Payer: [Insurance_Name] | Drug: [Drug_Name] | Dose: [Drug_Dose_Grams]g; log action in audit_log.xlsx with Action = BVS Assigned.
If BVS attempts BV and intake.xlsx col Consent_Status is not Signed, post to #intake-alerts: [CONSENT MISSING] CASE_ID and do not begin BV.
must_not: Do not state the diagnosis in the voicemail.
Do not proceed to BV before Consent_Status = Signed.
Do not continue after three failed contact attempts without alerting and emailing Template 1.
notes: Use verbatim scripts exactly as written.
Alert #intake-alerts immediately after the third failed attempt.
Document every call attempt in Contact_Attempt_Log.

procedures.name: 7.2 Drug Source Decision
procedures.applies_when: Immediately after benefits verification (BV) is completed for a case.

decisions.rule: CareIG_Network_Status = In-Network AND Specialty_Pharmacy_Required = NO
decisions.then: Drug_Source = CareIG

decisions.rule: CareIG_Network_Status = Out-of-Network AND Specialty_Pharmacy_Required = YES
decisions.then: Drug_Source = value from benefits.xlsx column Specialty_Pharmacy_Name; CareIG bills nursing and supplies only — do not bill any IVIG drug J-code on the CareIG claim.

decisions.rule: CareIG_Network_Status = Out-of-Network AND Specialty_Pharmacy_Required = NO
decisions.then: Post to #intakemgmt: [OON NO PREFERRED PHARMACY] CASE_ID; Supervisor must determine next step (single‑case agreement, patient referral, or self‑pay). Do not proceed until Drug_Source is confirmed by supervisor.

decisions.rule: Benefit_Type = Pharmacy
decisions.then: Post to #billing-mgmt: [BENEFIT TYPE ISSUE] CASE_ID; Await Director guidance. Do not proceed until resolved.

decisions.rule: CareIG_Network_Status = In-Network AND Specialty_Pharmacy_Required = YES
decisions.then: Drug_Source = value from benefits.xlsx column Specialty_Pharmacy_Name; CareIG bills nursing and supplies only. Do not bill any IVIG drug J‑code on the CareIG claim.

steps: Write the drug source to clinical.xlsx column Drug_Source according to the applicable decision rule.
If D2 or D5 applies, set Drug_Source to the Specialty_Pharmacy_Name from benefits.xlsx and ensure the CareIG claim includes only nursing and supplies (no IVIG drug J‑code).
If D3 applies, post to Slack channel #intakemgmt: "[OON NO PREFERRED PHARMACY] CASE_ID" and wait for supervisor confirmation before proceeding.
If D4 applies, post to Slack channel #billing-mgmt: "[BENEFIT TYPE ISSUE] CASE_ID" and await Director guidance before proceeding.
If D1 applies, set Drug_Source = CareIG.
must_not: Do not bill any IVIG drug J‑code on the CareIG claim when Specialty_Pharmacy_Required = YES.
Do not proceed until Drug_Source is confirmed by supervisor for out‑of‑network, no preferred pharmacy cases.
Do not proceed until Director resolves a pharmacy‑benefit issue.
notes: This decision step occurs immediately after benefits verification.
All Slack posts must use the exact channel names and message formats shown.

procedures.name: Formulary Check
procedures.applies_when: When preparing to submit a prior authorization (PA) for a case.

inputs.source: payer_rules.xlsx col Formulary_Covered_Drugs (row for the payer)

decisions.rule: Ordered drug is NOT listed in payer_rules.xlsx col Formulary_Covered_Drugs for the payer
decisions.then: Contact prescribing physician via phone to request an alternative covered drug or a written formulary exception letter.

decisions.rule: Physician provides a formulary exception letter
decisions.then: Save letter as formulary_exception.pdf, document basis in auth.xlsx col Formulary_Exception_Notes, include in PA packet, then proceed to Section 8.2.

decisions.rule: Physician substitutes an alternative covered drug
decisions.then: Update intake.xlsx col Drug_Name with the new drug and restart Section 8.1.
decisions.else: If neither provided within 2 business days, post unresolved notice and hold the case.

steps: Open payer_rules.xlsx and read the row for the payer identified in benefits.xlsx col Primary_Insurance_Name.
Check col Formulary_Covered_Drugs for the payer against the ordered drug (intake.xlsx col Drug_Name).
If the drug is not listed, call the prescribing physician using intake.xlsx col Physician_Phone to request either an alternative covered drug or a written formulary exception letter.

After the call (or if the physician could not be reached and the issue remains), post to #intake-team with the exact format: [FORMULARY ISSUE] CASE_ID | Drug: Drug_Name | Payer: Insurance_Name. Do NOT post this notice if physician guidance already on file (Section 4.4) resolves the issue.

If the physician provides a formulary exception letter, save it as formulary_exception.pdf, record the rationale in auth.xlsx col Formulary_Exception_Notes, attach the PDF to the PA packet, and move to Section 8.2.
If the physician substitutes an alternative covered drug, update intake.xlsx col Drug_Name with the new drug and restart this Formulary Check (Section 8.1).
If neither an exception letter nor a substitution is received within 2 business days, post to #intake-mgmt with the format: [FORMULARY UNRESOLVED] CASE_ID and place the case on hold.
deadlines: Physician response (exception letter or alternative drug) must be obtained within 2 business days of the phone call.
must_not: Do not submit the PA until a covered drug or a valid formulary exception letter is confirmed.
Do not post a [FORMULARY ISSUE] notice if existing physician guidance (Section 4.4) already resolves the issue.
notes: Formulary check is a prerequisite for any PA submission.
Use the phone channel for physician contact as specified.
Maintain exact message formatting for Slack posts to #intake-team and #intake-mgmt.

links.when: Formulary issue resolved (exception letter or covered drug confirmed).
Physician substitutes an alternative covered drug.

procedures.name: 8.2 Required PA Documents
procedures.applies_when: When preparing to submit a Prior Authorization (PA) for a case.

inputs.fact: Physician Letter of Medical Necessity (signed, on letterhead, dated within 90 days)
Most recent IgG lab result (if applicable)

decisions.rule: Any required document is missing or invalid
decisions.then: Post alert to #intake-alerts and hold PA submission

steps: Save the payer‑specific PA request form as pa_form_[PayerName].pdf in the case folder.
Save the signed Physician Letter of Medical Necessity on letterhead, dated within 90 days, as lmn_[PhysicianName].pdf in the case folder.
If applicable, save the most recent IgG lab result as igglevel_[MMDDYYYY].pdf in the case folder.
Save the most recent physician progress note as progress_note_[MMDDYYYY].pdf in the case folder.
If applicable, save the formulary exception documentation as formulary_exception.pdf in the case folder.
If any required document is missing or invalid, post to #intake-alerts: "[PA HOLD] CASE_ID — [missing / invalid]: [document name]".
Do not submit the PA; follow procedure 4.2 (Stop Protocol) with reason "invalid file".
must_not: Submit the PA when any required document is missing or invalid.
Ignore the #intake-alerts notification.
notes: Letter of Medical Necessity must be dated within the last 90 days.
Only include IgG lab result and formulary exception documentation when they are applicable to the case.

procedures.name: PA Submission
procedures.applies_when: When a case has all required prior‑authorization documents and is ready to be sent to the payer.
steps: Email to payer PA address (value from payer_rules.xlsx PA_Submission_Email) with Subject: [PA REQUEST] CareIG | [Patient Last Name] | MemberID: [Member_ID] | Drug: [Drug_Name] | Dose: [Drug_Dose_Grams]g | Dx: [Diagnosis_ICD10]; attach all required PA documents.
Update auth.xlsx: set PA_Submission_Date = today, PA_Status = Pending, Last_Followup_Date = today.
Post to Slack channel #intake-team: "[PA SUBMITTED] [CASE_ID] | Payer: [name] | Drug: [Drug_Name]".
Log to audit_log.xlsx: Action = PA Submitted.
deadlines: All steps must be completed on the same business day the PA is ready for submission.
must_not: Do not submit the email without attaching all required PA documents.
notes: High‑priority action – submit as soon as the required documents are gathered.
Ensure the subject line follows the exact format for tracking.

procedures.name: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Request
procedures.applies_when: When a payer offers a P2P review after a denial.

inputs.fact: Payer offers a P2P review after denial

decisions.rule: P2P_Status = Requested AND P2P_MD_Response_Date is blank AND (today - P2P_Request_Date) >= 2 days
decisions.then: Post to #intake-alerts: [P2P NO RESPONSE] CASE_ID; set P2P_Status = No Response; proceed to Level 1 appeal (Section 11).

steps: Call payer, obtain time slots, record in auth.xlsx column P2P_Available_Slots.
Complete Template 2 (Appendix A). Save as p2p_request.pdf.
Email p2p_request.pdf to the address in intake.xlsx column Physician_Email with subject line "[P2P REQUEST] [CASE_ID] | [Payer]".
Set auth.xlsx column P2P_Status = Requested and P2P_Request_Date = today.
deadlines: If no MD response within 2 days of P2P_Request_Date, trigger alert and move to Level 1 appeal.
notes: Record payer‑provided time slots accurately.
Use the exact subject line format for the email.
Follow the 2‑day monitoring rule strictly to avoid delays.

procedures.name: PA Approval — Clinical Handoff
procedures.applies_when: When a Prior Authorization (PA) is approved by the payer.

inputs.fact: PA_Number, PA_Approved_Drug, PA_Approved_Dose, PA_Approved_Frequency, PA_Effective_Date, PA_Expiration_Date, PA_Status

inputs.source: case record (intake.xlsx or case management system)
determined earlier in workflow (e.g., intake.xlsx or decision log)

decisions.rule: lowercase(PA_Approved_Drug) != lowercase(intake.Drug_Name)
decisions.then: Post drug mismatch alert to #intake-alerts and halt scheduling until resolved.

decisions.rule: PA_Approved_Dose < intake.Drug_Dose_Grams
decisions.then: Post dose mismatch alert to #intake-alerts, do not schedule, and require BVS to contact payer for full dose approval.

steps: Save PA approval as pa_approval_[PayerName].pdf.
Update auth.xlsx: set PA_Number, PA_Approved_Drug, PA_Approved_Dose, PA_Approved_Frequency, PA_Effective_Date, PA_Expiration_Date, PA_Status = Approved.
Update clinical.xlsx: set Handoff_Status = Received, PA_Number, PA_Expiration_Date.
Post to #clinical-scheduling: [PA APPROVED] [CASE_ID] | Drug: [PA_Approved_Drug] | Dose: - [PA_Approved_Dose]g | PA#: [PA_Number] | Exp: [PA_Expiration_Date] | Drug Source: [Drug_Source].

If PA_Approved_Drug does not match intake.xlsx column Drug_Name (case‑insensitive), post to #intake-alerts: [PA DRUG MISMATCH] CASE_ID | Ordered: [Drug_Name] | Approved: [PA_Approved_Drug]. Resolve with payer before scheduling.

If PA_Approved_Dose is less than intake.xlsx column Drug_Dose_Grams, post to #intake-alerts: [PA DOSE MISMATCH] CASE_ID | Ordered: [Drug_Dose_Grams]g | Approved: [PA_Approved_Dose]g. Do not schedule. BVS must contact payer to request approval for the full ordered dose before proceeding.
Log to audit_log.xlsx: Action = PA Approved — Clinical Handoff.
must_not: Do not schedule the patient while a drug mismatch or dose mismatch alert is active.
notes: Priority: Resolve any mismatch alerts before any clinical scheduling actions.
All postings must follow the exact message format shown in the SOP.

links.when: No drug or dose mismatches remain.

procedures.name: PA Denial Handling
procedures.applies_when: When a prior authorization request is denied by the payer.

decisions.rule: PA_Status == 'Denied'
decisions.then: Proceed to Section 11 (Appeal Management)

steps: Update auth.xlsx: set PA_Denial_Date = today, PA_Denial_Reason = denial text, PA_Status = Denied.
Post to #billing-appeals channel: [PA DENIED] [CASE_ID] | Payer: [name] | Reason: [PA_Denial_Reason].
Log to audit_log.xlsx: Action = PA Denied.
deadlines: All three actions must be completed on the same business day the denial is received.
notes: High priority – immediate posting triggers the appeal workflow in Section 11.

procedures.name: Nurse Scheduling for IVIG Home Infusion
procedures.applies_when: When an IVIG infusion visit must be scheduled for a patient case.

inputs.fact: Nurse credential requirement (RN for first visit, state‑specific rule for subsequent visits)
Ordered drug name and dose range

inputs.source: infusion_duration.xlsx row matching Drug_Name and Dose_Range column Estimated_Visit_Length

inputs.fact: Drug details for nurse email (lot number, NDC, infusion rate, pre‑med orders, emergency contact, contraindications)
inputs.source: intake.xlsx columns Lot_Number, NDC, Infusion_Rate, Pre_Med_Orders, Emergency_Contact, Contraindications

decisions.rule: Nurse zip code matches patient zip code AND nurse credential satisfies requirement (RN required for first visit; otherwise per payer_rules.xlsx Nursing_Credential_Requirement)
decisions.then: Assign matching nurse to the case

steps: 20. Select nurse matching patient zip code and credential (RN required for first visit; verify state rules in payer_rules.xlsx col Nursing_Credential_Requirement for subsequent visits).
21. Create calendar event: Title = "IVIG Visit — [CASE_ID]" and add the assigned nurse as an attendee.
22. Set event duration using the estimated infusion times from infusion_duration.xlsx. Look up the row matching the ordered drug and dose range to find the estimated visit length in hours.

23. Confirm the visit with the patient using the script: "Hello [Patient Name], this is [Your Name] from CareIG. Your insurance has approved your IVIG infusion. We have availability on [Date] at [Time] — does that work for you? The visit will take approximately [X] hours."

24. Update clinical.xlsx with Visit_Date, Visit_Time, and Nurse_Assigned. Post a message to #clinical-scheduling channel using the format: [SCHEDULED] [CASE_ID] | Date: [Visit_Date] | Nurse: [Nurse_Assigned].

25. Email the assigned nurse. Subject: "[VISIT ASSIGNMENT] [CASE_ID] | [Date]". Include patient address, drug name, dose, lot number, NDC, infusion rate, pre‑med orders, emergency contact, and contraindications (sourced from intake.xlsx).
notes: RN credential is mandatory for the first infusion visit.
Verify state‑specific nursing credential rules before assigning a non‑RN for subsequent visits.

procedures.name: 10.3 Claim Submission
procedures.applies_when: When a claim.xlsx has been prepared and is ready for submission for a specific date of service.
steps: Export claim.xlsx to PDF named claim_[DOS].pdf.

Email claim_[DOS].pdf to the payer billing address (from payer_rules.xlsx column Claim_Submission_Email) with subject line: "[CLAIM SUBMISSION] CareIG NPI: [NPI] | [Patient Last Name] | MemberID: [Member_ID] | DOS: [Visit_Date]".
After sending, update claim.xlsx: set Submission_Date = today, Submission_Ref_Number = email confirmation ID, and Claim_Status = Submitted.
Post a message to the #billing channel: "[CLAIM SUBMITTED] [CASE_ID] | DOS: [Visit_Date] | Payer: [name] | Billed: $[Total_Billed]".
Log the action to audit_log.xlsx with Action = "Claim Submitted".
deadlines: All steps must be completed on the same business day the claim is ready for submission.
notes: Verify that the PDF version matches the data in claim.xlsx before emailing.
Confirm the payer email address is current in payer_rules.xlsx before sending.

procedures.name: 10.4 ERA & Payment Posting
procedures.applies_when: When an ERA or EOB document is received from a payer via email.

inputs.fact: Patient name, DOS, billed amount, insurance payment, patient balance

decisions.rule: Paid_Amount < Contracted_Rate
decisions.then: Post underpayment message to #billing-mgmt and do not write off.

decisions.rule: ERA contains any CARC‑coded line with $0 paid
decisions.then: Create denial worksheet and follow Section 11.

decisions.rule: Patient_Responsibility > 0
decisions.then: Generate and email patient statement.

steps: Download the ERA/EOB attachment from the email received at billing@careig.com and save it as era_[DOS]_[Payer].pdf.

Compare Paid_Amount to payer_rules.xlsx column Contracted_Rate; if Paid_Amount < Contracted_Rate, post to #billing-mgmt: [UNDERPAYMENT] CASE_ID | Payer: [name] | Expected: $[rate] | Received: $[paid] and do not write off.

If the ERA contains a denial (any CARC‑coded line with $0 paid), copy denial_blank.xlsx to create DENIAL_[CARC]_[DOS].xlsx and populate CARC_Code, Denial_Date, DOS, Denied_Code, Denied_Amount; then follow Section 11.
Update claim.xlsx: set Payment_Posted_Date = today and Claim_Status = Paid / Partially Paid / Denied as appropriate.

If Patient_Responsibility > 0, complete patient_statement_template.docx with patient name, DOS, billed amount, insurance payment, and patient balance; save as statement_[DOS].pdf; email the PDF to the patient using the address in intake.xlsx column Patient_Email with subject "CareIG Statement of Account | DOS: [Visit_Date]".
deadlines: All actions to be performed upon receipt of the ERA/EOB document.
must_not: Do not write off underpayment when Paid_Amount is less than Contracted_Rate.
Do not send a patient statement when Patient_Responsibility equals 0.
notes: Underpayment notifications should be posted to #billing-mgmt immediately for timely follow‑up.
Denial worksheets must be created using the exact naming convention DENIAL_[CARC]_[DOS].xlsx.

procedures.name: 11.2 Appeal Submission
procedures.applies_when: When a claim is denied and an appeal (Level 1 or Level 2) must be filed.

inputs.fact: Case ID, DOS, Payer, CARC code, Submission Ref Number, Member ID

decisions.rule: (today − Appeal_Submitted_Date) ≥ 15 days AND Appeal_Status = "Submitted"
decisions.then: Call payer appeal department and log call in payer_rules.xlsx column Followup_Log.

decisions.rule: Appeal_Level = "Level 2" AND Appeal_Status = "Denied"
decisions.then: Post to #billing-mgmt channel and notify Director of Revenue Cycle for next action.

steps: Gather from: original claim PDF, PA approval, physician LMN, visit_note export, and ERA/EOB showing the denial.
Complete appeal_template.docx and save as appeal_L[1 or 2]_[DOS].pdf.

Email appeal to the address in payer_rules.xlsx column Appeal_Submission_Email. Subject line: [APPEAL L[1/2]] CareIG | [Patient Last Name] | MemberID: [Member_ID] | DOS: [DOS] | Claim: [Submission_Ref_Number] | CARC: [code]. Attach all gathered documents.
Update appeals/appeals_log.xlsx with DOS, CARC_Code, Appeal_Level, Appeal_Submitted_Date, and set Appeal_Status = "Submitted".
Post to Slack channel #billing-appeals: [APPEAL FILED L[1/2]] [CASE_ID] | DOS | Payer | CARC.

If (today − Appeal_Submitted_Date) ≥ 15 days and Appeal_Status = "Submitted", call payer appeal department, then log Date, Time, Rep name, Reference #, and Next follow‑up date in payer_rules.xlsx column Followup_Log.
If Level 2 appeal is denied, post to #billing-mgmt: [L2 DENIED] CASE_ID. Director of Revenue Cycle determines next action (write‑off, IRO request, or state commissioner complaint).
Log the action "Appeal Submitted" to audit_log.xlsx.
deadlines: Appeal email must be sent immediately after completing the appeal PDF.
Follow‑up call must be made no later than 15 days after Appeal_Submitted_Date if status remains "Submitted".
must_not: Do not email the appeal without attaching all required documents (original claim PDF, PA approval, physician LMN, visit_note export, ERA/EOB).
notes: Level 1 appeals are filed first; only if denied proceed to Level 2.
All log updates must be performed in the exact files and columns named by the SOP.
